newsitem.title: USA: Fingerhut sees solid results for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Fingerhut sees solid results for 1997.

text.p: Fingerhut Cos Inc said Thursday its marketing strategies and cost controls have set the company on track to post solid results for the full year 1997.
"We produced solid results in the first quarter and are on track to deliver for the full year," said chairman and chief executive Ted Deikel.
Fingerhut reported a first quarter profit of $0.05 a share versus a loss of $0.04 last year.

"Our efforts to reduce costs and streamline processes are paying off," Deikel said. "Cost reduction continues to be a major strategic effort at Fingerhut and will help position the company for profitable, long-term growth."
Fingerhut said the loss for its Direct-to-the-Consumer Marketing Segment narrowed to $3.7 million or $.08 a share from a loss of $5.9 million or $0.12 a share.
Metris Cos Inc, Fingerhut's 83 percent-owned financial services subsidiary, boosted consolidated earnings by $0.13 a share, up from $0.08 a share last year.
Fingerhut is a database marketing company which sells products and services through its catalog and direct marketing company.
